# Bibliography

- Ansberry, Christopher B. "What Does Jerusalem Have to Do with Athens?: The Moral Vision of the Book of Proverbs and Aristotle's Nicomachean Ethics." _Hebrew Studies_ 51, no. 1 (2010): 157–73.
- Bland, Dave. "The Formation of Character in the Book of Proverbs." _Restoration Quarterly_ 40, no. 4 (1998): 221–37.
- Brown, William P. "The Formation of Character in Proverbs; or, Virtue and the Art of Community Maintenance." In _Character in Crisis: A Fresh Approach to the Wisdom Literature of the Old Testament_, 22–39. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans, 1996.
- Brown, William P. "The Pedagogy of Proverbs 10:1-31:9." In _Character and Scripture: Moral Formation, Community, and Biblical Interpretation_, 150–182. Grand Rapids: Eerdmans, 2002.
- Culp, A. J. "In My Father's House: The Place of Wonder in Proverbs' Vision of Education." In _Wondering about God Together: Research-Led Learning and Teaching in Theological Education_, edited by Les Ball and Peter G. Bolt, 254–269. Macquarie Park: SCD Press, 2018.
- Fox, Michael V. "The Pedagogy of Proverbs 2." _Journal of Biblical Literature_ 113, no. 2 (1994):
- 233–43.
- Fox, Michael V. "Ideas of Wisdom in Proverbs 1-9." _Journal of Biblical Literature_ 116, no. 4 (1997): 613–33.
- Fox, Michael V. "The Social Location of the Book of Proverbs." In _Texts, Temples, and Traditions: Essays in Honor of Menahem Haran_, edited by Michael V. Fox, Victor Avigdor Horowitz, Avi Hurvitz, Michael L. Klein, Baruch J. Schwartz, and Nili Shuck, 227–239. Winona Lake: Eisenbrauns, 1996.
- Khobnya, Andrey. "Formation and Education in Proverbs 1–9: Theological and Pedagogical Principles." _Didache: Faithful Teaching_ 7, no. 2 (2008): 1–30.
- Melchert, Charles F. _Wise Teaching: Biblical Wisdom and Educational Ministry_. Trinity Press International, 1998.
- Van Leeuwen, Raymond C. "Liminality and Worldview in Proverbs 1–9." _Semeia_ 50 (1990):
- 111–144.
- Whybray, R. N. "The Book of the Ten Discourses." In _Wisdom in Proverbs: The Concept of Wisdom in Proverbs 1-9_, 33–52. Studies in Biblical Theology. Naperville: Alec R. Allenson, Inc., 1965.

## Artwork

- Cover Page: de Neter, Laurentius. _The Broad and the Narrow Way_. 1630. Oil on panel, 59 × 78 cm. Museum Catharijneconvent.
- Page iii-iv: Follower of Fre Seyon. _Diptych with Mary and Her Son Flanked by Archangels, Apostles and a Saint_. Late 15th century. Glue tempera on panel, 25.4 × 19.05 × 1.91 cm. The Walters Art Museum.
- Page v–vi: Bruyn, Abraham de. _King Solomon Writing the Book of Proverbs_. 1583. Engraving on paper, 164 × 113 mm. Rijksmuseum.
- Page vii: Cole, Thomas. _The Voyage of Life: Manhood_. 1842. Oil on canvas, 134.3 × 202.6 cm.
- National Gallery of Art.
- Page 3: Giorgione. _Three Philosophers_. 1508. Oil on canvas, 25.5 × 146.2 cm. Kunsthistorisches Museum.
- Page 4–5: Toorenvliet, Jacob. _Benediction Being Read in the Synagogue_. 1670. Oil on canvas, 66 × 82.5 cm. National Museum of Art.
- Page 6: Giovanni Guidi, Giovanni di ser. _The Seven Liberal Arts_. 1460. Tempera on wood with gold finishes, 50 cm × 159 cm. Museu Nacional d'Art de Catalunya.
- Page 7: Pesellino, Francesco. _Seven Liberal Arts_. 1450. Tempera on panel, 41.5 × 147.3 cm.
- Birmingham Museum of Art.
- Page 9: Follower of Rembrandt van Rijn. _An Elderly Man in Prayer_. 1660. Oil on canvas, 87.3 × 72 cm. The Cleveland Museum of Art.
- Page 10–11: Greuze, Jean-Baptiste. _The Bible Reading_. 1755. Oil on canvas, 65.3 × 82.4 cm.
- Louvre Museum.
- Page 15: Dou, Gerrit. _Old Man Praying_. 1670. Oil on panel, 18 × 12.7 cm. Leiden Collection.
- Page 17–18: da Castelfranco, Giorgione. _The Three Ages_. 1500. Oil on panel, 62 × 77 cm.
- Palazzo Pitti.
- Page 20: Anonymous. _Wisdom Has Built Her House_. 1548. Tempera on wood, 146 × 106 cm.
- State Tretyakov Gallery.
- Page 23: Friedrich, Caspar David. _The Stages of Life_. 1834. Oil on canvas, 72.5 × 94 cm.
- Museum der bildenden Künste.
- Page 24: Barbieri, Giovanni Francesco. _King David_. 1651. Oil on canvas, 223.5 × 170.2 cm.
- National Gallery.
- Page 26–27: Haanen, George Gillis. _The Night School_. 1835. Oil on panel, 64 × 50 cm.
- Rijksmuseum.
- Page: 30–31: Botticelli, Sandro. _Young Man Before the Seven Liberal Arts_. 1445. Fresco, tempera, plaster, 238 × 284 cm. Louvre Museum.
- Page 34: Anonymous. _Panel Portrait of a Man_. Late 1st Century CE. Encaustic (wax and pigments) on wood, 39.4 × 20.5 cm. The Walters Art Museum.
- Page 35: Anonymous. _Panel Portrait of a Woman_. 2nd Century CE. Encaustic (wax and pigments) on wood, 44 × 18.9 × 1.4 cm. The Walters Art Museum.
- Page 38: Pourbus, Pieter. _Two Wings of a Triptych with Portraits of Donors with Saints Adrian and John the Baptist_. 1530. Oil on panel, 91 × 29 cm. Rijksmuseum.
- Page 40–41: Drost, Willem. _Standing Young Man at the Window in His Study Reading_. 1647.
- Oil on canvas, 79.5 × 88.7 cm. Statens Museum for Kunst.
